_about: OmegaWeapon company archetypes. Phase 0 names ONE primary archetype (optionally a secondary). The archetype decides which modules run by default, how the scorecard is weighted, which Codex overlay sections bind, and which market nome the Horus read uses. Modules: crawl, technical, content, local, links, competitors, paid, social, ai, apps, exposure, agency, market, copy. Every archetype always runs crawl, technical, content, exposure (web layer), agency and market; the table lists what is added or switched off.

archetypes.label: Local service business
archetypes.examples: trades, clinics, law firms, salons, restaurants, dealers with one lot
exports_to_request: Google Ads exports (campaign / search terms / conversions / Policy manager)
Local pack and review panel screenshots

archetypes.label: Multi-location / franchise
archetypes.examples: retail chains, dental or vet groups, dealer groups, banks, gyms
archetypes.center_of_gravity: the estate: location pages, locator, per market packs
exports_to_request: Merchant Center / local inventory if retail
App Store Connect / Play Console if a loyalty app exists

archetypes.label: National e-commerce / DTC
archetypes.examples: Shopify and headless stores, marketplaces sellers, subscription boxes
archetypes.center_of_gravity: catalog health, feeds, paid efficiency, creative
exports_to_request: Google Ads (Shopping / PMax channel report / Demand Gen)

archetypes.label: B2B / SaaS
archetypes.examples: software vendors, professional services firms selling nationally, martech
archetypes.center_of_gravity: docs and pricing crawlability, corroboration layer, competitor set
exports_to_request: Google Ads + Microsoft Ads exports with offline conversion import status

archetypes.label: Marketplace / directory / lead-gen / aggregator
archetypes.examples: quote marketplaces, directories, comparison sites, lead networks
exports_to_request: Google Ads exports incl. Policy manager
Meta Account Quality + special ad category declarations
Crawl export (Screaming Frog / Sitebulb) for facets

archetypes.label: Publisher / media / creator
archetypes.examples: news sites, niche publishers, newsletters, creator brands
archetypes.center_of_gravity: AI dependence and the referral floor, page experience, syndication
exports_to_request: GSC 16 mo incl. Discover and News tabs

archetypes.label: Healthcare / wellness
archetypes.examples: practices, clinics, telehealth, supplements, med spas, therapy providers
archetypes.center_of_gravity: exposure first (health data, pixels, claims), then local and growth
exports_to_request: Google Ads incl. Healthcare certification status
Meta Account Quality + data-source restriction level

archetypes.label: Legal
archetypes.examples: law firms of any size, legal lead generators
archetypes.center_of_gravity: bar compliance, the local pack, LSA
exports_to_request: Google Ads exports incl. Policy manager
Bar advertising filing receipts where a state requires filing

archetypes.label: Financial services / fintech / lending
archetypes.examples: lenders, BNPL, lease to own, banks, credit unions, brokers, insurance
exports_to_request: Google Ads incl. Financial products certification
Meta credit special category declarations + verification status
CFPB complaint export (public API is also pulled)

archetypes.label: Real estate / housing / mortgage
archetypes.examples: brokerages, agents, property managers, mortgage originators, home builders
archetypes.center_of_gravity: fair housing exposure, local, listing feeds

archetypes.label: Automotive
archetypes.examples: dealers, dealer groups, repair shops, parts retailers, detailers
archetypes.center_of_gravity: inventory feeds, local, vehicle listing ads
exports_to_request: Google Ads incl. vehicle listing ads

archetypes.label: Education
archetypes.examples: schools, colleges, bootcamps, tutoring, online course sellers
archetypes.center_of_gravity: claims exposure, enrollment funnels, campus local
exports_to_request: Google Ads incl. Title IV claim review

archetypes.label: App-first / consumer app
archetypes.examples: consumer apps, games with a small site, fintech apps

archetypes.label: Agency / martech / review platform / lead-gen network
archetypes.examples: SEO, PPC, web design and social agencies; martech vendors; directory and review platforms
archetypes.center_of_gravity: claims, badges, outreach, the client book patterns, what it sells vs what the floor says works
exports_to_request: The agency's own GSC and GA4
Its own Google Ads and Meta exports
Client list or badge phrasing (for the Roll Call)
Received cold emails (.eml) if outreach is in question

archetypes.label: Other regulated or specialty vertical
archetypes.examples: government-adjacent, care and funeral, pets, travel, food, alcohol or cannabis, gambling, adult, weapons, tech and AI products
archetypes.center_of_gravity: per the Codex overlay for the vertical
exports_to_request: Ads exports for the platforms in use
Licensing and registration numbers for the vertical
